domains.name: 行情数据
domains.description: Real-time market data subscription, display, K-line charting, and 5-level depth quote. Data flows from CTP OnRtnDepthMarketData through the backend to the frontend via WebSocket push.

entities.name: 行情快照
entities.description: Single instrument's real-time market data including last price, bid/ask 5-level prices, volume, open interest, OHLC, and limit prices. Mapped from CTP CThostFtdcDepthMarketDataField.

entities.name: K线柱
entities.description: OHLCV candlestick bar aggregated from real-time ticks. Supports 1m/5m/15m/30m/1h periods. Volume is computed as per-tick delta (CTP volume is cumulative).

entities.name: 五档行情
entities.description: 5-level bid/ask order book extracted from the latest snapshot. Filters CTP invalid prices (DBL_MAX).

entities.name: 合约信息
entities.description: Instrument metadata including exchange, product, volume multiplier, price tick, expiry date, and option-specific fields. Loaded from CTP ReqQryInstrument or local instruments.json.

entities.name: 行情订阅
entities.description: Tracks which instruments are currently subscribed for real-time market data. Max 500 contracts. Managed by MarketService.

relationships.description: 5-level depth extracted from snapshot bid/ask fields
Ticks aggregated into OHLCV bars by KLineService
Contract metadata needed before subscribing
Subscribed instruments receive real-time snapshots via CTP

domains.name: 交易报单
domains.description: Order submission, cancellation, bulk cancel, reverse position, and lock position. Orders flow through OrderManager which wraps TraderApi and tracks in-memory state updated by CTP callbacks.

entities.name: 报单
entities.description: A trading order submitted to CTP. Contains instrument, direction, offset flag, price, volume, time/volume conditions. Tracked in-memory by OrderManager with state updates from OnRtnOrder/OnRtnTrade callbacks.

entities.name: 成交回报
entities.description: A trade execution resulting from an order fill. Recorded per-order in OrderManager._trades and broadcast via WebSocket.

entities.name: 止损单
entities.description: Conditional order that monitors market data and automatically submits an order when the stop price is triggered. Persisted to disk with GFD semantics. Status lifecycle: pending -> triggering -> triggered/canceled/trigger_failed.

entities.name: 反向委托组
entities.description: Composite operation: close existing position and open opposite direction. Supports serial (close then open) and parallel (simultaneous) execution modes. Handles SHFE close_today/close_yesterday split.

entities.name: 锁仓委托
entities.description: Opens an equal-volume opposite position without closing the original. Used for hedging risk while retaining the existing position.

relationships.description: Filled orders generate trade records
Stop order auto-submits a real order when stop price hit
Reverse operation creates close + open order pair
Lock operation creates an opposite-direction open order
Real-time price data triggers stop order conditions
Market orders use snapshot price as protection price

domains.name: 查询服务
domains.description: Query order history, trade history, positions, and account balance from CTP. Results are cached in QueryService and refreshed on demand. CTP uses the bIsLast accumulation pattern for multi-batch responses.

entities.name: 持仓
entities.description: Investor position data including instrument, direction (long/short), volume, cost, profit, and margin. Queried from CTP ReqQryInvestorPosition.

entities.name: 账户资金
entities.description: Trading account fund information including balance, available funds, margin, commission, and profit. Queried from CTP ReqQryTradingAccount.

entities.name: 报单流水
entities.description: Historical order records queried from CTP. Distinct from in-memory OrderManager state — these are CTP's authoritative records.

entities.name: 成交流水
entities.description: Historical trade execution records queried from CTP.

relationships.description: Positions are the result of filled orders
Trades reference orders via orderRef
Account margin/profit aggregates across all positions

domains.name: 期权交易
domains.description: Option contract filtering, option chain aggregation (T-type quotes by underlying + expiry), and implied volatility calculation using Black-Scholes model with Newton-Raphson iteration.

entities.name: 期权合约
entities.description: Option instrument with type (call/put), strike price, expiry date, and underlying instrument. Filtered from instrument list by productClass='2'.

entities.name: 期权链
entities.description: Options grouped by underlying instrument and expiry date, with calls and puts separated and sorted by strike price. Used for T-type quote display.

entities.name: 隐含波动率
entities.description: IV calculated via Newton-Raphson method on Black-Scholes formula. Requires option price, underlying price, strike, time to expiry, and risk-free rate. Capped at 500% (non-physical limit).

relationships.description: Option contracts grouped into chains by underlying + expiry
IV computed per option contract from market data
IV calculation requires real-time option and underlying prices from snapshots

domains.name: 连接管理
domains.description: CTP connection lifecycle management for both Market Data (MD) and Trading (TD) channels. MD connects at startup independently; TD requires validated credentials. Includes automatic reconnection with exponential backoff.

entities.name: 行情连接
entities.description: Market Data front connection. Connects at server startup, runs independently of login. Uses CThostFtdcMdApi. Auto-reconnects on disconnect.

entities.name: 交易连接
entities.description: Trading front connection. Requires login with broker/user/password credentials. Uses CThostFtdcTraderApi. Must confirm settlement before placing orders.

entities.name: 重连服务
entities.description: Automatic reconnection with exponential backoff (base 1s, max 5 retries). After successful reconnect, re-subscribes previously tracked instruments.

relationships.description: MD connection receives and delivers market data
TD connection required for order submission
Reconnect service restores MD connection on failure
Reconnect service restores TD connection on failure

domains.name: 实时推送
domains.description: WebSocket-based real-time data push from backend to frontend. Multiple endpoints for different data types. Includes heartbeat monitoring and dead connection cleanup.

entities.name: WebSocket端点
entities.description: 5 dedicated WebSocket endpoints for different data channels: market data, order returns, position updates, stop order updates, and system status.

entities.name: WebSocket消息
entities.description: Typed messages pushed through WebSocket channels. Includes market_data, order_return, trade_return, position_update, stop_order_update, connection_status, instruments_refreshed, ping, error.

relationships.description: market endpoint pushes real-time snapshots
order endpoint pushes order/trade returns
position endpoint pushes position updates
stop endpoint pushes stop order status changes

domains.name: 用户偏好
domains.description: User-configurable preferences persisted in localStorage. Includes selected contracts, hotkey bindings, and quick trade configuration.

entities.name: 快捷键配置
entities.description: Keyboard shortcut bindings for trading actions: buy, sell, cancel, reverse, lock, batch cancel.

entities.name: 快捷交易配置
entities.description: Configuration for lock and reverse operations including price mode (counterparty/market), offset ticks, time condition (GFD/FAK), and execution mode (serial/parallel).

relationships.description: Hotkeys trigger order operations
Quick trade config controls reverse behavior
Quick trade config controls lock behavior

flows.name: 行情数据推送流程
flows.description: Real-time market data flows from CTP exchange through the backend to the frontend display. The bridge pattern connects CTP worker threads to the async web layer.
flows.trigger: CTP OnRtnDepthMarketData callback fires in CTP worker thread
flows.outcome: Frontend market table, K-line chart, and depth quote update in real-time

steps.name: CTP回调触发
steps.description: CTP exchange pushes depth market data via OnRtnDepthMarketData callback in the CTP worker thread

steps.name: 字段映射
steps.description: ctp_bridge calls map_depth_market_data() to convert PascalCase CTP fields to camelCase dict

steps.name: 快照缓存更新
steps.description: MarketService.update_snapshot() stores/merges the data in thread-safe snapshot cache

steps.name: K线聚合
steps.description: KLineService.update_tick() aggregates the tick into OHLCV bars for 1m/5m/15m/30m/1h periods

steps.name: 止损单检查
steps.description: StopOrderService.on_market_data() checks if any pending stop orders should trigger

steps.name: WebSocket广播
steps.description: broadcast_fn() bridges from CTP thread to async loop, pushing data to all /ws/market connections

steps.name: 前端状态更新
steps.description: useMarketWs hook receives WebSocket message and updates Zustand market store (snapshots, klineData)

steps.name: UI渲染
steps.description: Market table (vtable), K-line chart (ECharts), and depth quote component re-render with new data

flows.name: 报单提交流程
flows.description: User submits an order through the frontend form, which goes through validation, CTP submission, and callback-driven state tracking.
flows.trigger: User fills order form and clicks submit (or uses hotkey)
flows.outcome: Order submitted to CTP exchange, status tracked and displayed

steps.name: 前端校验
steps.description: Order store validates: instrument selected, valid price, volume within limits (market: 60/30, limit: 500/100), protection price within limit range

steps.name: 字段转换
steps.description: convertOrderRequest() maps frontend enums (buy/sell/open/close) to CTP char codes (0/1/3)

steps.name: API请求
steps.description: POST /api/order/insert sends InsertOrderRequest to backend

steps.name: 后端校验
steps.description: Pydantic model validates: direction pattern [01], offsetFlag [013], priceType [12], volume limits, FOK/FAK constraints

steps.name: OrderManager提交
steps.description: OrderManager.insert() creates pending record, registers response event, calls TraderApi.insert_order()

steps.name: CTP报单
steps.description: TraderApi builds CThostFtdcInputOrderField and calls ReqOrderInsert on the CTP API

steps.name: 回调等待
steps.description: OrderManager blocks on threading.Event (3s timeout) waiting for OnRspOrderInsert or OnRtnOrder callback

steps.name: 状态更新
steps.description: Callback updates order state (accepted/rejected/canceled). OrderManager broadcasts order_return via WebSocket

steps.name: 前端反馈
steps.description: Toast notification shows success/failure. Query store upserts order for real-time tracking

flows.name: 止损单触发流程
flows.description: Stop order monitors market data and auto-submits an order when the stop price condition is met.
flows.trigger: Market data tick arrives for an instrument with pending stop orders
flows.outcome: Stop order triggers and submits a real order to CTP

steps.name: 提交止损单
steps.description: User submits stop order via POST /api/order/stop with stopPrice, direction, offsetFlag, limitPrice

steps.name: 持久化存储
steps.description: StopOrderService saves stop order to data/stop_orders.json with status=pending

steps.name: 行情监听
steps.description: ctp_bridge wires stop_order_callback to OnRtnDepthMarketData. Each tick calls StopOrderService.on_market_data()

steps.name: 触发条件检查
steps.description: For each pending stop order on the instrument: buy stop triggers when lastPrice <= stopPrice, sell stop triggers when lastPrice >= stopPrice

steps.name: 状态转换
steps.description: Atomic status change: pending -> triggering (prevents duplicate triggers via lock)

steps.name: 自动报单
steps.description: OrderManager.insert() called with the stop order's parameters. Market trigger uses limitPrice as protection price

steps.name: 结果记录
steps.description: On success: status=triggered, orderRef recorded. On failure: status=trigger_failed. Persisted to disk

steps.name: WebSocket通知
steps.description: stop_order_update broadcast to /ws/stop connections with updated stop order status

flows.name: CTP登录流程
flows.description: Trading connection login flow. MD connects independently at startup; TD requires explicit login with credentials.
flows.trigger: User clicks login in ConnectionPanel (or auto-login from saved credentials)
flows.outcome: TD authenticated and ready for order submission

steps.name: MD自动连接
steps.description: At server startup, ctp_startup creates MdUserApi, registers SPI, connects to MD front, and logs in (no credentials needed)

steps.name: 用户登录请求
steps.description: POST /api/connection/login with brokerID, userID, password

steps.name: TD连接创建
steps.description: connect_trading() creates TraderApi, registers SPI, connects to TD front

steps.name: 前置连接回调
steps.description: OnFrontConnected callback fires, triggering ReqUserLogin

steps.name: 登录认证
steps.description: CTP validates credentials. OnRspUserLogin returns FrontID/SessionID

steps.name: 结算确认
steps.description: ReqSettlementInfoConfirm sent to confirm daily settlement (required before trading)

steps.name: OrderManager初始化
steps.description: OrderManager.set_session() records FrontID/SessionID for stale callback filtering

steps.name: 服务接线
steps.description: Wire ctp_bridge (market data -> services), OrderManager callbacks (order/trade returns), stop order monitoring

flows.name: 断线重连流程
flows.description: Automatic reconnection when CTP front disconnects. Uses exponential backoff and re-subscribes instruments after reconnect.
flows.outcome: Connection restored with all subscriptions re-established

steps.name: 断线检测
steps.description: CTP OnFrontDisconnected callback fires. Connection status set to 'disconnected'

steps.name: 重连计数
steps.description: ReconnectService.on_disconnect() increments retry count

steps.name: 指数退避
steps.description: Delay = base_delay * 2^attempt (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s). Max 5 retries

steps.name: 重连尝试
steps.description: ReconnectService.try_reconnect() calls connect_fn to re-establish CTP connection

steps.name: 重新订阅
steps.description: On success, re-subscribes all previously tracked instruments via subscribe_fn

steps.name: WebSocket通知
steps.description: System WebSocket broadcasts connection_status update to frontend

flows.name: 期权链查询流程
flows.description: User browses option chains with T-type quotes and implied volatility analysis.
flows.trigger: User selects underlying instrument in Options panel
flows.outcome: Option chain displayed with calls/puts grouped by strike, IV calculated

steps.name: 标的筛选
steps.description: GET /api/market/options/underlyings returns available underlying instruments (e.g., IF2608)

steps.name: 期权链查询
steps.description: GET /api/market/option_chain with underlying + expire_date filter

steps.name: 合约筛选
steps.description: OptionsService.get_options() filters instruments by productClass='2', then by underlying

steps.name: 期权链聚合
steps.description: OptionsService.get_option_chains() groups by (underlying, expireDate), separates calls/puts, sorts by strike

steps.name: 波动率计算
steps.description: GET /api/market/volatility calculates IV via Newton-Raphson on Black-Scholes for each option with valid prices

steps.name: 前端展示
steps.description: Options store renders T-type quote table with calls on left, puts on right, strikes in center, IV overlay

flows.name: 一键反向流程
flows.description: Close existing position and open opposite direction in one operation. Supports serial and parallel execution modes.
flows.trigger: User clicks reverse button or presses hotkey
flows.outcome: Position direction reversed with appropriate close/open orders

steps.name: 持仓查询
steps.description: Get current positions for the instrument from QueryService. Validate position exists

steps.name: 保护价获取
steps.description: For market orders: get protection price from snapshot (lastPrice -> preClosePrice -> openPrice fallback chain)

steps.name: 平仓下单
steps.description: Submit close order. SHFE special: split into close_today (offsetFlag='3') + close_yesterday (offsetFlag='1') if both exist

steps.name: 开仓下单
steps.description: Submit opposite-direction open order. Serial: wait for close acceptance first. Parallel: submit simultaneously

steps.name: 结果汇总
steps.description: Return all order results (close_today, close_yesterday, open) with individual success/failure status

flows.name: 查询刷新流程
flows.description: Refresh orders, trades, positions, and account data from CTP. Uses the bIsLast accumulation pattern with 10s timeout.
flows.trigger: User clicks refresh button or periodic auto-refresh
flows.outcome: Query data updated in frontend display

steps.name: 前端触发
steps.description: refreshAll() in query store triggers serial refresh with 1.2s delay between queries (CTP rate limit)

steps.name: 后端查询
steps.description: POST /api/query/{type}/refresh triggers QueryService to call TraderApi query method

steps.name: CTP回调积累
steps.description: CTP sends multiple OnRspQryXxx callbacks with partial data. bIsLast=True on final batch

steps.name: 结果缓存
steps.description: QueryService accumulates results, caches on bIsLast, signals waiting thread

steps.name: 前端更新
steps.description: Query store updates orders/trades/positions/account state. New items highlighted

steps.name: CTP字段映射
steps.description: Bidirectional mapping between CTP PascalCase fields and frontend camelCase. Covers 6 data structures: DepthMarketData, InputOrder, Order, Trade, Instrument, Position, Account.

steps.name: 回调SPI架构
steps.description: Composition-based SPI design (not CTP SPI inheritance). BaseSpi provides event logging + custom handler registration. MdSpi and TraderSpi extend BaseSpi with CTP-specific callbacks.

steps.name: CTP线程桥接
steps.description: Glue between CTP worker threads (sync callbacks) and async web layer (WebSocket broadcasts). The bridge pattern connects: CTP thread -> map fields -> update cache -> broadcast async.
steps.pattern: Thread-safe bridge with async coroutine scheduling

steps.name: 报单状态机
steps.description: Order status lifecycle: pending (local) -> a (CTP initial/Unknown) -> 2 (NoTraded)/1 (PartTraded)/0 (AllTraded)/5 (Canceled). Active statuses: pending, a, 2, 3, 1. Terminal: 0, 5.

steps.name: 止损单状态机
steps.description: Stop order lifecycle: pending -> triggering (intermediate, prevents duplicate) -> triggered/canceled/trigger_failed. GFD semantics: only today's pending orders loaded on startup.

steps.name: K线聚合算法
steps.description: Aggregates CTP ticks into OHLCV bars. CTP volume is cumulative: per-tick delta = current - last. First tick for a new instrument gets delta=0. Bar boundaries computed from ActionDay+UpdateTime timestamps.

steps.name: 隐含波动率计算
steps.description: Newton-Raphson iteration on Black-Scholes formula. Layers: (1) arbitrage boundary check (intrinsic value, upper bound), (2) iteration with step limiting and IV cap at 500%. Handles vega collapse near expiry.
steps.algorithm: Newton-Raphson with Black-Scholes, max 100 iterations, tolerance 1e-6

steps.name: 上期所平今平昨拆分
steps.description: SHFE/INE exchanges require separate orders for close_today (offsetFlag='3') and close_yesterday (offsetFlag='1'). Reverse/lock operations detect exchange and split accordingly.

steps.name: 数量限制规则
steps.description: CTP exchange-imposed volume limits: Market+Future=60, Market+Option=30, Limit+Future=500, Limit+Option=100. Validated both frontend and backend.

steps.name: CTP会话过滤
steps.description: After reconnection, CTP may replay historical OnRtnOrder callbacks from previous sessions. OrderManager filters stale callbacks by comparing (frontID, sessionID) against the current session identity set during login.
